## Highlights
- **🕒 Updated time and grade in New & Updated Assignments.** Every row on the Overview page's **New & Updated Assignments** box now shows exactly when it was last updated, like "updated today 3:42 PM", and its grade on the right (for example **A (90%)**) once the teacher has graded it.

## Changes
- **Updated time:** when the assignment was posted or its due date or name changed, or when it was graded if that happened later. Shows "today" or "yesterday" plus the time, or the date for older ones.
- **Grade:** the letter and percent, in the same style as the Recently Updated Grades box. Ungraded assignments show no grade.
- Grades on rows you already had fill in by themselves the next time Overview reads your classes (at most every 15 minutes).
- Also in 2.15: **New grade alerts**, a Chrome notification when a teacher posts or changes a grade. Turn it on or off under **Reminders** in the Alma+ menu.

## How to update
1. Download the zip below and unzip it.
2. Copy its files over your old Alma+ folder (same place, same folder name).
3. Go to `chrome://extensions` and click reload ↻ on Alma+, then refresh Alma.
4. Open Alma's **Overview** page and look at **New & Updated Assignments**.

> ⚠️ Don't remove the extension to update — removing it deletes your saved tasks. Back up your tasks first with **Back up tasks** on the To Do page if you're unsure.
